verdicts.reason: A is a real vertical re-layout with readable text, but it has clear flaws. The Quillbrook logo is blown up into a huge roundel that competes with the headline. The headline and subcopy are left-aligned while the logo and CTA are centred, so the alignment is mixed. The subcopy wraps with a short 'or more.' line, and the CTA feels small under the dominant logo. B is the original banner shrunk into a thin strip across the middle of a 300x600 canvas. The subcopy and the 'Shop Coffee' button text are illegibly tiny, and about 90% of the canvas is empty brown. There is no adaptation to the tall format, so it is unusable.
